narration.description: Spoken consequence of the applied mutations. Pure text: no state, no rules, no numbers the tracker did not produce.

mutations.description: Applied by the deterministic tracker as soon as this array closes, BEFORE any of the narration is voiced. Every entry must be valid or the whole round is rejected.

id.description: stable id within this round, e.g. m1

tool.description: tracker tool name, e.g. spend, craft, damage, give, move

actor.description: party slot 1-4, monster index, or null for the world

intent.description: short player-facing intent string; never authority over state

args.description: tool arguments; the tracker validates and may reject

description: Emission order: narration BEFORE mutations, so TTS can start while the mutations are still being generated. The gate applies nothing until the whole object parses, so this buys 3.1-6.8s of spoken latency and costs nothing (notes/voice-stack.md). Key order is the order of `properties`, not of `required` - the grammar walks properties. Never add a non-property key to `properties` (a `_note` key there becomes a field the model must emit).
